REVIEW.title: Expectations, Outcomes, and Challenges of Modern Code Review

official_page_metadata.venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Software Engineering

supported_facts: The paper is an empirical study of tool-based modern lightweight code review at Microsoft.
Observed motivations/outcomes include defect finding, knowledge transfer, team awareness and alternative solutions.
Code/change understanding is central; the publication is not a specification of one fixed multi-agent organization.
not_supported_as_a_paper_requirement: The project-specific exact-version acceptance and fixed submission protocol.
proposed_report_sentences: 来源为Bacchelli与Bird在ICSE 2013发表的现代代码复核实证研究，研究讨论了缺陷发现、知识传递和替代方案等作用。
本项目仅借鉴“开发—独立复核—返修”闭环，设置001开发兼交付、002复核，不额外设置经理；固定两人和同版本接受规则属于我们的实现，不是原论文的完整复现。
diagram_cautions: Place developer001 and reviewer002 at the same visual level, connected by candidate/feedback arrows.
The developer remains the designated final producer; reviewer feedback does not automatically modify or deliver001’s private tree.
Do not label the reviewer as a manager or claim the original paper prohibits managers.
Same-model separate sessions are role independence, not independent statistical samples.

SPRINT.title: The 2020 Scrum Guide

official_page_metadata.HTML_relation: Direct port of the November 2020 PDF

supported_facts: The Scrum Team includes a Product Owner, a Scrum Master and Developers, with no internal hierarchy and with self-management.
The Product Owner orders the Product Backlog; the Scrum Master supports team effectiveness and self-management.
Developers select work with the Product Owner and decide how to implement the selected work.
The guide permits delivery before the Sprint ends and explicitly does not make Sprint Review a release gate.
relevant_sections: Sprint Planning: Topics Two and Three
not_supported_as_a_guide_requirement: Exactly four members or exactly two Developers.
Product Owner or Scrum Master as a manager assigning individual coding tasks.
Scrum Master authorizing code editing, patch publication or release.
A tool-level active-Sprint check that blocks fix_patch before recorded activation.
proposed_report_sentences: 来源为Schwaber与Sutherland的《Scrum Guide》2020版：团队自管理，PO负责目标与待办排序，SM促成团队有效性，开发者自行安排实现。
本项目将其适配为003担任PO、004担任SM、001与002担任开发者的四人组；启动记录和固定／交付权限是项目协议，不能把这些额外门槛解释为Scrum本身要求经理审批。
diagram_cautions: Put all four roles inside one self-managing team boundary, not a PO→SM→developers hierarchy.
Draw developers001 and002 side by side; distinguish001 designated delivery responsibility as a project rule.
Label PO edges goal/backlog ordering and SM edges facilitation/impediment removal, rather than commands or approval.
If actual org_sprint_start and fix_patch gates are drawn, label them as ProWorkSim implementation/evidence rules, separately from the source framework.
Do not draw Sprint Review as a mandatory release-approval gate.

copy_policy: Paraphrased notes only; no full paper or guide content copied.
